title: Formation of the Aztec Triple Alliance
summary: In 1428 the Mexica of Tenochtitlan joined Texcoco and Tlacopan to defeat the Tepanec city of Azcapotzalco, a leading power in the Valley of Mexico. The three-city alliance, with Tenochtitlan the dominant partner, then expanded by conquest and tribute until the Spanish conquest of 1521.

uncertainty.note: The Mexico City government timeline places the death of Tezozomoc, which opened the crisis, in 1427; the alliance and defeat of Azcapotzalco are given as 1428 by the other sources.

as_recorded.value: In 1428, Itzcóatl gathered the council in Tenochtitlán and demanded war against Azcapotzalco
These two empires came face to face in 1428 with the Tepanec War

where.historical_name: Tenochtitlan, Mexica city-state in the Valley of Mexico (allied with Texcoco and Tlacopan)

importance.justification: Created the political core of the Aztec Empire that the Spanish confronted in 1519–1521.

sources.title: Aztec Civilization: The Last Mesoamerican Empire
